heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: 103 dead, 1,666 injured, 185,131 displaced after M7.7 quake struck 68km NNW of Ende at 10km depth on 15 August; BMKG has recorded 7,029+ aftershocks and predicts continued shaking into September. President Prabowo's visit to the disaster zone remains unscheduled ten days on.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
